newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SmarTone seen in HK$1.79 bln share offer -- paper.
newsitem.headline: SmarTone seen in HK$1.79 bln share offer -- paper.

text.p: SmarTone Mobile Communications Ltd is expected to float 25 percent of its share capital at a price ranging HK$17.25 to HK$21.25 per share, raising around HK$1.79 billion, the Sing Tao Evening Post reported on Friday.
The report said about 84 million shares would be placed internationally and 12.6 million shares would be for sale in Hong Kong.
Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on October 31.
Sponsors and underwriters of the issue comprise Goldman Sachs, HSBC Investment, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Stanley, Schroders and Nomura, the report said.

SmarTone is owned 40 percent by Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd, 30 percent by AT&T Wireless Communications, 15 percent by ABC Communications (Holdings) Ltd and 15 percent by China's Ministry of Post and Telecommunications unit Town Khan Ltd.
A spokeswoman for the company said no information was available at this stage. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
